items.title: A bounded below pseudo-coherent complex whose fibre vanishes in low degrees becomes perfect after localizing
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: 证明 11 行但有实推演：先把界 a 抬高使复形本身在下界以下消没（不是只对纤维成立），再用「切开复形」在局部化后把低截断与高截断分开并得到高截断完美，因低截断为零而知 K 本身完美，最后用「由剩余域提升完美」把它表示成题面那串自由模复形。三步都在 span 内；2 处同章引用作桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-lift-bounded-pseudo-coherent-to-perfect (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 19999-20017

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the shift of the bound so the complex itself vanishes in low degrees, the local splitting off of the low truncation by the cutting statement, and the passage to a finite free representation by the lifting statement (source lines 20019-20029)
